About the Role

As a Senior Collection Operations Manager at GoTo Financial, you will be responsible for leading and managing both in-house and outsourced (BPO) collection operations across our lending portfolios. You will drive collection performance, operational efficiency, and workforce productivity while ensuring adherence to regulatory requirements and internal collection standards. You will work closely with Collection Strategy, Risk, Quality Assurance, and other cross-functional stakeholders to build scalable, effective, and sustainable collection operations.

What Will You Do

• Lead end-to-end collection operations across in-house and BPO teams, taking ownership of collection performance, operational KPIs, and recovery targets across lending portfolios.
• Drive operational excellence by continuously improving collection processes, workforce productivity, resource allocation, and cost efficiency.
• Manage BPO partnerships and performance, ensuring vendors deliver against agreed performance targets, service-level agreements (SLAs), quality standards, and contractual obligations.
• Lead and develop high-performing collection teams, including supervisors, team leaders, collectors, and agency coordinators, through structured performance management, coaching, and capability development.
• Ensure operational compliance and governance by enforcing collection policies, regulatory requirements, and quality assurance standards while proactively mitigating operational and reputational risks.
• Translate collection strategies into operational execution, partnering with Collection Strategy, Risk, and other stakeholders to ensure effective implementation of segmentation, treatment strategies, and collection initiatives.
• Drive operational transformation and scalability through process standardization, workflow automation, technology adoption, and data-driven performance management.

What Will You Need

• Minimum 8 years of experience in collection operations within fintech, banking, or consumer lending, with at least 3 years in a managerial leadership role.
• Proven experience managing large-scale collection operations, including both in-house and outsourced (BPO) collection teams.
• Strong understanding of collection methodologies, delinquency management, recovery strategies, and operational performance metrics.
• Demonstrated experience in BPO vendor management, including performance evaluation, capacity planning, SLA management, and cost optimization.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate operational data into actionable performance improvement initiatives.
• Sound knowledge of Indonesian collection regulations, consumer protection requirements, and operational risk management.
• Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage multiple layers of operational teams and drive execution in a fast-paced environment.

About the Team

The Collections team at GoTo Financial plays a critical role in ensuring the sustainable growth and profitability of our lending business across GoPay Later, GoPay Pinjam, and Merchant Lending. We manage end-to-end collection activities across digital, telecollection, and field collection channels, balancing recovery effectiveness, operational efficiency, regulatory compliance, and customer experience.

Our team combines data-driven collection strategies, technology, and operational execution to continuously improve how we manage delinquency at scale. We are committed to transforming traditional collection practices into intelligent, technology-enabled, and scalable operations through automation, advanced analytics, and AI-driven solutions.

About GoTo Group
GoTo is the largest digital ecosystem in Indonesia. GoTo's mission is to 'empower progress' by offering technology infrastructure and solutions that help everyone to access and thrive in the digital economy.
The GoTo ecosystem provides a wide range of services, including mobility, delivery, payments, financial services, and technology solutions for merchants. The ecosystem also provides e-commerce services through Tokopedia and banking services through its partnership with Bank Jago.

About Gojek
Gojek is Southeast Asia’s leading on-demand platform and pioneer of the multi-service ecosystem with over 2.5 million driver partners across the regions offering a wide range of services such as transportation, food delivery, logistics and more. With its mission to create impact at scale, Gojek is committed to resolving consumer problems and raising standards of living by connecting consumers to the best providers of goods and services in the market.

About GoTo Financial
GoTo Financial accelerates financial inclusion through its leading financial services and merchants solutions. Its consumer services include GoPay and GoPayLater and serve businesses of all sizes through Midtrans, Moka, GoBiz Plus, GoBiz, and Selly. With its trusted and inclusive ecosystem of products, GoTo Financial is open to new growth opportunities and aims to empower everyone to Make It Happen, Make It Together, Make It Last.

GoTo and its business units, including Gojek and GoToFinancial ("GoTo") only post job opportunities on our official channels on our respective company websites and on LinkedIn. Key Responsibilities

1. Contract and Transaction Support

• Draft, review and negotiate agreements, order forms, correspondence and other legal documents for transactions within the assigned scope.
• Support pre-contract and post-contract activities, including contract execution, implementation, amendments, renewals, termination and contractual claims.
• Develop and maintain standard contract templates and legal playbooks to improve consistency and efficiency in deal execution.
• Coordinate with business teams and other relevant functions to ensure that contractual terms reflect agreed commercial arrangements and appropriate legal safeguards.

2. Contractual Compliance and Risk Management

• Identify and assess legal and contractual risks in proposed transactions and recommend practical mitigation measures.
• Review agreements and arrangements for compliance with applicable laws, regulations and internal policies relevant to the assigned scope.
• Support the incorporation of appropriate contractual protections and advise on relevant internal approval requirements.
• Escalate material risks, unresolved issues and deviations from approved contractual positions to the reporting manager in a timely manner.
• Work with relevant internal functions to address compliance issues arising during contract negotiation and implementation.

3. Legal Advisory and Business Support

• Provide day-to-day legal advice on the negotiation, execution, implementation, management and enforcement of contracts within the assigned scope.
• Monitor legal and regulatory developments relevant to telecommunications, AI, cloud, technology and commercial activities, and assess their implications for the Company.
• Conduct legal research and prepare clear, practical advice to support business decisions.

Qualification

Education

Min. bachelor’s degree in law (SH) from reputable universities in Indonesia.

Related Experienced

Min. 3-4 years of relevant experience in-house or at a law firm, preferably involving the drafting, review and negotiation of commercial and technology agreements, customer/reseller or revenue-sharing arrangements, strategic partnerships or transaction documents. Good knowledge of Indonesian contract and commercial law and relevant regulatory requirements. Exposure to the telecommunications, AI/cloud, data centre or technology infrastructure industry is an advantage.

Human Competency

• Strong analytical, drafting, negotiation, presentation and communication skills.
• Able to work independently and collaboratively, with a proactive, solutions-oriented and “can-do” attitude.
• Resourceful, conscientious, thorough and well-organized, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver assignments within the required timeline.
• Able to work effectively with cross-functional stakeholders in a multicultural and changing organizational environment.
• Demonstrates sound judgment, integrity and appropriate escalation of material legal or contractual risks.

Generic Competency

• Fluency and proficieny in English and Indonesian language, MS Office (outlook, word, excel, ppt)
• Strong computer skills, including proficiency with Microsoft Office products (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Visio).
• Familiarity with the use of AI/GenAI tools to support legal work (e.g., contract drafting/review assistance, legal research, document summarization) is an advantage.

PT Japfa Food Indonesia

Job Summary**

Responsible for providing comprehensive administrative support to the Finished Goods (FG) warehouse operations, ensuring efficient documentation, record-keeping, and coordination to maintain smooth inventory flow and data accuracy.

Job Responsibilities**

* Manage and maintain accurate inventory records for finished goods, including incoming, outgoing, and stock movements, using the company's inventory management system.
* Process and verify all warehouse-related documentation, such as delivery orders, shipping manifests, goods receipt notes, and stock transfer forms.
* Coordinate with production, logistics, and sales departments to ensure timely and accurate information exchange regarding finished goods availability and dispatch.
* Assist in generating daily, weekly, and monthly reports on inventory levels, stock discrepancies, and warehouse activity.
* Prepare and organize physical and digital filing systems for all warehouse documents, ensuring easy retrieval and compliance with company policies.
* Support warehouse team in conducting regular stock counts and reconciliation activities.
* Communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders regarding order status, delivery schedules, and any issues related to finished goods.
* Maintain a clean and organized administrative workspace.
* Perform other administrative duties as assigned by the Warehouse Supervisor/Manager.

Job Qualifications**

* Minimum Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Proven experience (1-3 years) in a warehouse administration or inventory control role, preferably in a manufacturing or food industry setting.
* Proficient in using inventory management software and Microsoft Office Suite (especially Excel).
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy in data entry and record-keeping.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Understanding of warehouse operations and logistics processes.
* Willingness to learn and adapt to new systems and procedures.
